p: Nazarite: Who separated themselves from the world, and dedicated themselves to God: a figure which was accomplished in Christ.
dead body: As at burials, or mournings.
his head: In that he allowed his hair to grow, he signified that he was consecrated to God.
head of his consecration: Whose long hair is a sign that he is dedicated to God.
the dead: By being present where the deceased was.
consecrate unto the LORD the days: Beginning at the eighth day, when he is purified.
days that were before shall be: So that he shall begin his vow anew.
of his separation at the door: In token that his vow is ended.
put it in the fire which: For the hair which was consecrated to the Lord, might not be cast into any profane place.
beside that that his hand shall: At the least he shall do this, if he is not able to offer more.
bless the children of Israel: That is, pray for them.
name upon the children of Israel: They shall pray in my Name for them.
